These fixtures contain no credentials, account details, project names, or user files.

`legacy-greeting.jsonl` uses sanitized initialization and greeting shapes from the October 11 diagnostic export. Its final result and outgoing marker are reconstructed because the export ended during the response.

The other fixtures are synthetic protocol scenarios for background results, cancellation races, duplicate results, and retries. They use the same prompt-ownership gate and stream mapper as the live reader. They do not claim to be full live-Claude recordings.
